latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Subtitle Remover — remove hardcoded subtitles from videos using cloud GPUs.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) to remove burned-in subtitles.
- Fast subtitle removal (30–90 seconds per video), export in 1080p MP4 by default.
- Automatic cloud session setup with free credits for new users.
- Supports batch processing, timeline previews, and iterative editing workflows.
- Includes credit, status, and export management with clear error messages.
- Common video/audio formats supported for import and export.
